races.paceDynamic: Alliteration looks the only confirmed front runner and will set a comfortable sustainable pace with 18 runners spreading behind her over 2 miles. The prominent horses like Cool Native, Poetic Twist, Salsinha and Simply Natural will sit just off the pace, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Jo's Secret, Thurman and Baby Fish will be held up at the back by their jockeys. With soft ground testing stamina and only one pace-setter, the tempo will be steady rather than fierce, allowing the field to stay bunched until the business end. This setup strongly favours prominent horses who can track the leader and kick clear when the pace lifts — they get the best of both worlds with a manageable early gallop and prime striking position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses can track Alliteration comfortably and the pace stays manageable.
scenarios.body: The likes of Cool Native, Salsinha and Simply Natural get perfect stalking positions before unleashing their finish, while the hold-up brigade face too much ground to make up on the testing soft surface. The race becomes a battle between the prominent runners in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Alliteration gets an easy lead and the field allows her too much rope in the testing conditions.
scenarios.body: Her proven soft ground form (4/4 record) and fitness edge from a recent 32-day break allows her to build an unassailable advantage, with the chasing pack unable to close the gap on ground that saps their stamina reserves. Jack Kennedy's booking of Cool Native suggests connections fear this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly and the prominent horses go too hard chasing Alliteration.
scenarios.body: The early leaders empty out in the soft ground, creating the perfect setup for a strong closer like Jo's Secret or Thurman to sweep up from the back with a well-timed run. The testing surface plays into the hands of horses with the strongest stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Longshot
scenarios.trigger: If Alliteration stops or prominent horses make tactical errors in the large field.
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with runners getting hampered or taking wrong routes, opening the door for an unconsidered runner like Strong Contender or Cool As A Cat to steal through. Norman Lee's double entry suggests he has realistic hopes despite their lowly ratings.

races.paceDynamic: Bioluminescence will take the field along from the front without pressure, creating a steady but not demanding gallop through the early stages. The prominent brigade of Mystical Goddess, Broomfield Bijou, Kilbarry Saint, and May Call You Back will track within striking distance, while the hold-up contingent including Ballybawn Belter, Me Wee Bonnie Lass, Ad Caelum and Crescent Moon will need to rely on the pace quickening late. With only one confirmed front-runner and multiple horses comfortable racing prominently, the tempo is likely to be controlled rather than cut-throat. This setup moderately favours prominent racers who can position handily and kick when the pace lifts — they get the best of both worlds without the energy-sapping early burn that pure hold-up horses need.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Favours Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Bioluminescence sets steady fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get an ideal setup to travel comfortably before unleashing their finishing kicks, while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the testing ground. Mystical Goddess and Kilbarry Saint are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Hold-Up
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group pressures Bioluminescence early, creating a searching pace
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop stretches the field and sets up perfectly for the closers who have the class and stamina to reel in tiring leaders. Ballybawn Belter's RPR of 151 and Me Wee Bonnie Lass's recent form make them prime beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Bioluminescence gets soft sectionals and maintains a strong position turning for home
scenarios.body: The mare's class (OR 142) and Mark Walsh's tactical nous allow her to kick clear when the field comes under pressure, exploiting her natural front-running advantage. Her recent second at Leopardstown on similar going suggests she's primed to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is extremely sedate and multiple horses have chances late
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops where positioning and luck become crucial, potentially allowing an outsider with tactical speed to capitalise. The soft ground amplifies stamina demands, making this a lottery for horses getting clear runs.

races.paceDynamic: Dancing Jeremy and Lord Lariat will dispute the early lead, with Dancing Jeremy showing better recent form including a win at this trip on soft ground. The pace should be genuine but not breakneck, as both leaders have tactical speed rather than pure front-running tendencies. With 17 runners and multiple hold-up horses including Kings Hill, Dutch Schultz, and Lucky Lyreen, the field will be well strung out behind the pace. This setup moderately favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly — the genuine pace will set up a strong finish for those with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace between Dancing Jeremy and Lord Lariat proves testing enough to soften the leaders.
scenarios.body: The strong pace will string out the field and allow the closers to pick up the pieces in the final furlong. Kings Hill, Dutch Schultz and Lucky Lyreen all have the class and tactical speed to benefit from this shape.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Dancing Jeremy Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Dancing Jeremy can dictate terms without facing serious early pressure from Lord Lariat.
scenarios.body: His recent soft ground form is excellent and Heffernan can control the tempo to suit, allowing him to kick clear when it matters. The 11-year-old's experience in these conditions gives him a significant edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and tie up, leaving the race to prominent runners.
scenarios.body: The midfield prominent horses who tracked the pace without getting involved in the early battle can surge through. Choccabloc and Lisleigh Lad are best placed to capitalize on this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lord Lariat Revival
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Lariat's 93-day break has freshened him sufficiently and the headgear change sparks improvement.
scenarios.body: Despite poor recent form, his class rating suggests ability remains and McLoughlin's string is in good heart. The longer break could have done him the world of good on this testing ground.

races.paceDynamic: This will be run at a relentless gallop with Petit Secret, Sine Qua Non, and He Can't Dance all committed to leading — three proven front-runners with the class to sustain a strong pace over 2m4f. Dubhain and Papagei will likely join the early battle, creating a punishing tempo that will test stamina reserves in the testing ground conditions. The large field of 26 runners means those towards the rear will face a traffic nightmare, while the strong early pace will string out the field significantly. This setup strongly favours prominent racers and patient hold-up horses with proven stamina — the pace is genuine and those getting first run from off the speed will have a decisive advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three main pace-setters (Petit Secret, Sine Qua Non, He Can't Dance) all commit early and the gallop is genuine throughout
scenarios.body: The leaders will weaken in the final furlong after a brutal pace, allowing the patient hold-up horses with class to sweep past late. Midnight Jet and Largy Star benefit most from this collapse, with their proven ability to finish strongly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives Duel
scenarios.trigger: If one of the main pace-setters gets the better of the early battle and finds enough left in the tank
scenarios.body: Petit Secret's class tells with Townend's tactical nous, or He Can't Dance's stamina proves superior in the testing conditions. The winner holds on grimly as the field closes but maintains enough of a margin.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but not suicidal, allowing a horse tracking the leaders to time their run perfectly
scenarios.body: Treasure Memory or one of the prominent runners gets the ideal trip behind the pace battle and has enough left to strike decisively. They avoid the worst of the early pace but stay close enough to pounce.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a stamina slog where unexposed types can outbattle the proven performers
scenarios.body: The testing conditions and strong pace play to the strengths of a lightly-raced improver who has been working well at home. Barnpark or one of the unknowns benefits from the collapse of more fancied rivals.

races.paceDynamic: This will be an absolute scorcher from flag to finish. Daydream Nation, Hens Tooth, Star Of The Week, Panjandrum, Blow Wind Blow and Fou De Toi ensure a relentless gallop over this stamina-sapping 3m trip on testing ground. The pace will be genuine throughout with multiple leaders scrapping for control, stretching the field and testing every horse's staying power to the limit. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace is genuine and the field will be strung out, allowing closers to pick up the pieces as the early leaders capitulate.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses profit
scenarios.trigger: If the pace burns hot as expected with multiple leaders going at it from the start
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop will string out the field and exhaust the pace-setters, allowing patient hold-up performers to sweep through tired horses in the final furlong. The testing ground and stamina-sapping distance play perfectly into the hands of horses held back for one late charge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker wins
scenarios.trigger: If one horse settles perfectly behind the pace without getting involved in the early speed battle
scenarios.body: A horse like Court Compliance or Vitorio Piel can track the leaders without expending energy, then strike decisively when the pace-setters weaken approaching the final flight. Their positioning allows them to capitalise on both the strong pace and avoid the early burn-up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives shock
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple pace-setters cancel each other out and one breaks clear to dictate alone
scenarios.body: Daydream Nation or Star Of The Week could steal a march if they can break free from the early scrum and set their own tempo. Their recent form suggests they have the class to sustain a long lead on this testing ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast and the race falls apart entirely
scenarios.body: The multiple front-runners could set such a fierce pace that they all stop dramatically, leaving the race to any horse that finishes. This would turn it into a lottery where any runner staying on strongly could benefit from the carnage up front.

races.paceDynamic: Kotkito Bello is the sole confirmed front runner in this 19-runner field and will dictate proceedings from the off, likely setting a manageable gallop given the lack of pace pressure. With most of the field comprised of hold-up performers (Hello Neighbour, Karbau, Helvic Dream, Sea Of Sands, Messerschmitt, Lord Erskine, Davy Crockett, Zillow, Putapoundinthejar, Missus Beeton, Bokamsin) and a smaller contingent racing prominently (Puturhandstogether, Sony Bill, Murcia, Mode Avion, Playtime, Powerful, Kalix Delabarriere), the race will develop into a sprint from the final hurdle. The soft ground will emphasize stamina over speed, creating a searching test that will suit horses with proven staying power. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the steady early pace will bunch the field and create a cavalry charge finish where class and stamina tell.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady and the field stays compact turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last and the classiest hold-up performers with proven soft ground form come to the fore. Quality horses like Hello Neighbour, Karbau and Helvic Dream can use their superior ratings and tactical speed to strike late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If several prominent racers press Kotkito Bello and create a stronger gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and suits horses that can travel strongly in behind the leaders without getting too far back. Horses like Puturhandstogether and Mode Avion can capitalize on their forward positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Kotkito Bello Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Kotkito Bello gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina reserves for a final kick
scenarios.body: The front runner's proven course form and soft ground ability allow him to repel late challengers in the testing conditions. His recent wins suggest he's in the form of his life and ready for this step up in class.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop becomes pedestrian and the race turns into a slow-run affair
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace plays into the hands of horses with tactical speed but the race becomes a lottery with little form significance. Quality may not prevail in a sprint finish from a crawling pace.

watchPoints.text: Kotkito Bello could steal a march if he gets an easy lead - his recent course wins and front-running style make him very dangerous
Several Willie Mullins runners including Karbau with Paul Townend suggest the champion trainer has identified his main chance
The 5lb and 7lb claiming jockeys on Messerschmitt, Lord Erskine, Mode Avion, Kotkito Bello and Kalix Delabarriere could prove significant in a tight finish
First-time headgear on Playtime (hood) and Mode Avion's proven heavy ground form make them interesting at bigger prices
The 62-day absence for Sea Of Sands, Lord Erskine and Putapoundinthejar - watch the market for clues about their readiness

races.paceDynamic: Lilannbee will take the field along from the front without serious pressure, with the prominent runners Lizzie Twigg, Something Fabulous, Belladaball and Some Pretender settling just behind but unlikely to apply early heat. The hold-up horses Wonderful Everyday, Moyneard and Voladora Nora will drop out the back in what shapes as a fairly sedate early gallop. With only one confirmed leader and the majority of the field content to sit off the pace, this creates a tactical affair where the pace will only quicken late. This setup moderately favours prominent runners who can track the leader and have first run on the hold-up horses when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays steady and the prominent quartet get first run on the field
scenarios.body: The likes of Lizzie Twigg and Some Pretender can track Lilannbee into the straight and kick clear before the hold-up horses can get into gear. Their tactical positioning proves decisive in a race where speed from the front matters more than a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Wonderful Everyday or Moyneard produce their best form despite the tactical disadvantage
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuine enough late to set up their finishing kicks, with Wonderful Everyday's class (RPR 122) or Moyneard's recent form overcoming their poor positioning. The Mullins stable confidence in booking Patrick Mullins for Wonderful Everyday suggests they expect her to be competitive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Lilannbee capitalizes on the soft early pace to save energy for a sustained kick
scenarios.body: She dictates throughout and has enough left to repel all challengers, with her proven front-running ability and the lack of early pace pressure playing to her strengths. The 62-day break could have her primed for a peak effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes Gold
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and turns into a sprint finish where any horse can win
scenarios.body: The tactical nature of the race means form lines get thrown out the window and one of the outsiders like Belladaball or Voladora Nora can capitalize on a good position. Fresh legs and a turn of foot matter more than ratings in a slowly-run affair.

watchPoints.text: Lilannbee could get uncontested fractions and prove very hard to peg back if the pace stays steady throughout
Wonderful Everyday's booking of Patrick Mullins despite poor recent form suggests the Mullins team expect a big improvement
Something Fabulous returning from 174 days off in a tactical race where freshness could be crucial
Early pace development will be key - if anyone pressures Lilannbee early it changes the entire complexion
Late pace injection will determine whether hold-up horses can get competitive or if prominent runners dominate
